targets.runnerRequirement: Native Windows x86_64 hosted runner; verify the current image before activation.
targets.cToolchain: Visual Studio 2022 MSVC and CMake with C17 support
blockers: crates/de-ffi/build.rs rejects every target except Linux x86_64 and currently uses GCC/Clang-style flags and an ar archiver.
de-runtime exposes only the Linux adapter; Windows process, Job Object, handle-inheritance, and ConPTY semantics are not implemented.
No native Windows process or ConPTY integration suite exists.
enablementCriteria: Make DE-Shell C compilation and archiving target-aware, then pass native MSVC and CMake builds.
Implement the Windows process adapter with explicit handle ownership, Job Object containment, environment and path handling, and deterministic cleanup.
Implement ConPTY allocation, resize, non-blocking I/O, cancellation, and native integration tests.
Add a Windows workflow for formatting, build, unit, and integration checks; require it only after a clean native run and stable runner/toolchain pinning.

Run native arm64 process, PTY, resize, I/O, environment, exit, and cleanup tests.
